verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing API platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring jobs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers card issuance, transactions, credit lifecycle, webhooks, an MCP server, Stage and a simulator, but nothing documents scheduling recurring jobs or workflows. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
